chapter: Drumming days and neighborhood life, 1919 onward
title: Arriving in 1919: horse-drawn fire engines and following parades
summary: Ernie arrived in 1919, the last year of horse-drawn fire engines, and lived near Basin and St. Peter. As a boy he followed parades and bands.
